verify_duplicate_sources: run the mako_plugin to validate that gRPC library target groups don't contain duplicate .cc source files
review_mako_plugin: review the mako_plugin function that checks for One Definition Rule violations across gpr, grpc, and grpc++ libraries
test_mako_plugin: test the mako_plugin by passing a dictionary with libs containing duplicate .cc sources to trigger an exception
refactor_mako_plugin: refactor the mako_plugin to support additional target groups beyond gpr, grpc, and grpc++ unsecure variants
summarize_mako_plugin: summarize the mako_plugin which builds a source map per target group and raises errors on duplicate .cc files
